name: datahub-memory
description: Grounded institutional memory for data teams — a DataHub investigation agent backed by delapan write-time-resolved memory. Skills: /datahub-memory:investigate (memory-first loop: recall → walk lineage/incidents when memory is thin → persist findings → write back), /datahub-memory:recall (memory-only lookup with a deterministic freshness check), /datahub-memory:writeback (attach a description or report to a DataHub entity, mutation tools primary, emitter fallback). Backed by two MCP servers: memory (delapan-grounded findings, local tier) and datahub (mcp-server-datahub).
